target_customer: Large B2C companies in Europe (energy, telecom, insurance, media, e-commerce) with high phone call volumes
problem: Customer-facing operations such as sales calls, support and appointment booking need many human agents. telli runs AI agents that handle these calls and other channels.
business_model: B2B SaaS and usage-based AI voice platform for enterprises
product_category: AI voice agents and customer operations automation

founders.name: Finn zur Muehlen
founders.background_notes: YC page says he ran contact center operations for Enpal's heat pump unit.

founders.name: Philipp Baumanns
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was employee number 2 in Enpal's heat pump unit and scaled it.

founders.name: Seb Hapte-Selassie
founders.background_notes: Software engineer at Pitch.com per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time voice agents at enterprise call volumes needed telephony, low latency and multilingual voice, built on third party voice and model providers (TechCrunch names ElevenLabs and Cartesia). The hard part was reliability at scale, not new research.

defensibility.rationale: The voice agent stack relies on shared model vendors and competitors can copy it. Enterprise integrations and operations know-how from Enpal add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded voice agent platforms were active by 2025. No incumbent acquisition of telli was found. telli's own site publishes comparison pages against Vapi, Parloa and Bland.

market_need_then: Founders ran large contact center operations at Enpal and saw the cost of phone-based sales and support. TechCrunch reported in April 2025 more than 50 percent month over month revenue growth and nearly a million processed calls.

identity.visual_style: Clean B2B software site with customer logos and case studies
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct with bold claims such as the number one AI voice platform

brand_strength.rationale: The name is short, speakable and an exact .com, and the site publishes comparison pages. No press about the brand itself, mascot or community was found.

outcome_analysis: telli raised a $3.6M pre-seed in April 2025 and a $15M seed in July 2026 led by redalpine, with enterprise customers across Europe. Success factors are founder market fit from running Enpal's call operations, voice AI timing and an enterprise sales motion. The risk is a crowded field of well funded voice agent platforms.
notes: The $15M seed was seen in search results from tech.eu, Dealroom, Vestbee and a law firm release (Osborne Clarke); the tech.eu page itself could not be fetched because its safety check was rate limited, so details come from search summaries. Total raised reported as about $18.5M by most sources, $19.6M by Caplight. Competitor list left empty: the TechCrunch launch coverage names no competitors and competitor pages found are telli's own, dated later. YC page says Berlin, team of 25 in directory data, a later source mentions 16 employees. Outcome search found no layoffs, shutdown or acquisition.
